content.text: But when the Japanese visited Ford Motor Company, it wasn't fully implemented yet and oddly enough,
content.trans: 但是当日本参观过福特汽车公司时，它还没有完全实现，而且似乎有些奇怪。

content.text: they found this philosophy working already in a Piggly Wiggly.
content.trans: 他们发现这个哲学已经在肯德基里已经成功运作了。

content.text: What's a Piggly Wiggly?
content.trans: Piggly Wiggly 是一个中文的网络用语，通常用来表示“好吃”或“美味”。在中文中，“Piggly Wiggly”是一个品牌名，它在中国大陆地区被广泛使用。如果你需要更准确的信息，我建议你查阅相关的官方资料或者联系品牌方获取最准确的答案。

content.text: Piggly Wiggly was a chain of grocery stores in the United States.
content.trans: 猪小猪是一家在美国的连锁超市。

content.text: I'm not sure if they're still around, but yeah, they were really big and basically Piggly Wiggly
content.trans: 我不确定他们是否还在，但是的，他们真的很大，基本上就是小猪佩奇。

content.text: was using this to improve their whole system of shipping and of stocking and everything.
content.trans: 他们正在利用这个来改进他们的整个海运和库存系统。

content.text: Okay, so how does it work?
content.trans: 好的，那么它怎么工作的？

content.text: So basically what you try to do is make your processes more efficient,
content.trans: 所以基本上，你试图做的是让你的流程更高效。

content.text: reduce the amount of space you're using, etc.
content.trans: 减少你使用的空间，等等。

content.text: And this was really important for Japanese because, of course, they don't have that much space
content.trans: 而且，对于日本来说，这非常重要，因为，当然，他们没有那么多空间。

content.text: in Japan to have this huge warehouses like in other countries.
content.trans: 在日本，要像其他国家那样拥有如此庞大的仓库。

content.text: So what you're saying is they're producing goods just for the time they need it, right?
content.trans: 所以你说的正是他们只是为了需要时生产商品，对吗？

content.text: Exactly. So trying to not be overstocked or...
content.trans: 是的。所以尽量不要过度库存或...

content.text: Or have a long lead time or something.
content.trans: 或者有较长的缓冲时间或什么。

content.text: A long lead times where you have to keep something in a warehouse.
content.trans: 一个长的交货期，你需要把东西放在仓库里。

content.text: Yeah.
content.trans: 是。

content.text: Exactly.
content.trans: 正确翻译为中文是：“正好。”

content.text: So that's why it's so efficient.
content.trans: 所以，这就是为什么这么高效。

content.text: And also it's about improving the efficiency between processes.
content.trans: 而且，这也是提高过程之间的效率的问题。

content.text: So what's sometimes called a bottleneck, you can have really good processes in the beginning.
content.trans: 所以有时被称为瓶颈的状况，你可以在开始时有非常好的流程。

content.text: But in the end, maybe you have only one workstation that's taking all these orders and
content.trans: 但是最终，也许你只有一个工作站正在处理这些订单。

content.text: everything gets bottled up and it causes delays.
content.trans: 一切都被封存了，这导致延误。

content.text: Oh yeah.
content.trans: 哦，对了。

content.text: So in the dialogue, they want to implement the just-in-time strategy as a way of avoiding redundancies.
content.trans: 所以，在对话中，他们希望实施即时策略，以避免重复。

content.text: But it sounds to me like actually this might cause redundancies sometimes.
content.trans: 但是，这听起来好像实际上有时候会引发冗余。

content.text: Well, yeah, sometimes it does.
content.trans: 是的，有时候确实如此。

content.text: Sometimes when you make work stations more efficient or when you make all your processes work
content.trans: 有时当你使工作台更高效或当所有流程都运作得更好时。

content.text: more fluidly, sometimes inevitably you will have to lay off some people that are redundant.
content.trans: 更流畅地，有时不可避免你将不得不裁减一些冗余的人。

content.text: Okay.
content.trans: 好的。

content.text: Have you ever worked in a company where they've implemented just in time?
content.trans: 是的，我曾经在一家公司中工作过，他们实施了即时生产。

content.text: No, actually, I've never really worked at a place where this philosophy was working, but I did
content.trans: 是的，实际上我没有真正工作过一个地方，这个哲学正在起作用，但我没有亲身经历。

content.text: used to work at a place where we had Six Sigma, which is a little bit similar.
content.trans: 使用在我们曾经参加六西格玛培训的地方工作，这有点像。

content.text: Yeah.
content.trans: 是。

content.text: Well, I guess we'll need a lesson on Six Sigma, right?
content.trans: 嗯，我想我们可能需要学习六西格玛吧？

content.trans: 是的，我们将会看看是否能提出六西格玛，并且它意味着什么，这确实很有趣。

content.text: But we want to hear what you think.
content.trans: 但是，我们希望听听你的想法。

content.text: Yes, have you guys worked in a place where they used just in time?
content.trans: 是的，你们有没有在使用只在需要时就有的地方？
